name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 3 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 19 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-06-17, at wavelengths from 0.80 to 3.17 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
